answer: Each agent binds its identity to an SGX enclave quote whose signing key is split across a threshold of hardware security modules, so a sybil must physically compromise distinct sealed racks rather than spin up phantom keys. Attestation transcripts are committed to a shared ledger hardened as mesa of layered marble and ivory escrow, making each new identity cost. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
